verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              तदुदीर्णं गजानीकं बलं तव जनाधिप।  पाण्डुसेनामतिक्रम्य योधयामास सर्वतः॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said 0 monarch, that impetuous elephant squadron of yours fought everywhere getting the better of the Pandava army.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चालाः कुरवश्चैव योधयन्तः परस्परम्।  यमराष्ट्राय महते परलोकाय दीक्षिताः॥२॥
verses.english: The Panchalas and the Kauravas, determined to go to the next world, that is, the great region of Yama, fought with one another.
verses.bhavadeepa: तदुदीर्णमित्यारभ्य रात्रियुद्धे जयद्रथवधात्क्रोधहर्षविवशाः कौरवपाण्डवा इवान्येऽपि निर्मर्यादं प्रवर्तन्ते इति प्रदर्शनार्थम् ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: शूराः शूरैः समागम्य शर-तोमर-शक्तिभिः।  विव्यधुः समरेऽन्योन्यं निन्युश्चैव यमक्षयम्॥३॥
verses.english: Heroes encounter (rival) heroes smote one another with arrows, lances and darts and quickly sent one another of the region of Yama.

verses.sanskrit: रथिनां रथिभिः सार्धं रुधिरस्रावदारुणम्।  प्रावर्तत महद्युद्धं निघ्नतामितरेतरम्॥४॥
वारणाश्च महाराज समासाद्य परस्परम्।  विषाणैर्दारयामासुः सुसंक्रुद्धा मदोत्कटाः॥५॥
verses.english: Furious elephants mad with rage, O mighty monarch, advancing against one another, mangled one another with tusks.

verses.sanskrit: हयारोहान्हयारोहाः प्रास-शक्ति-परश्वधैः।  बिभिदुस्तुमुले युद्धे प्रार्थयन्तो महद्यशः॥६॥
पत्तयश्च महाबाहो शतशः शस्त्रपाणयः।  अन्योन्यमार्दयन् राजन्नित्यं यत्ताः पराक्रमे॥७॥
verses.english: O mighty-armed one, O tormentor of foes, hundreds of foot-soldiers armed with weapons rushed against one another with vigorous efforts.

verses.sanskrit: गोत्राणां नामधेयानां कुलानां चैव मारिष।  श्रवणाद्धि विजानीमः पञ्चालान्कुरुभिः सह॥८॥
verses.english: And, O worshipful sire, (in that terrible encounter) we could only distinguish the Kurus from the Panchalas by the names of their (respective) clans and families which we heard them utter.

verses.sanskrit: तेऽन्योन्यं समरे योधाः शर-शक्ति-परश्वधैः।  प्रैषयन्परलोकाय विचरन्तो ह्यभीतवत्॥९॥
verses.english: The warrior moving about fearlessly on the field of battle sent one another to the next world by arrows, darts and battle-axes.
verses.bhavadeepa: गोत्रं पित्रादि नाम शैनेय सात्यके इत्यादि कुलं पांड्यपांचाल्येत्यादि ॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: शरा दश दिशो राजंस्तेषां मुक्ताः सहस्रशः।  न भ्राजन्ते यथातत्त्वं भास्करेऽस्तंगतेऽपि च॥१०॥
verses.english: The sun having gone down, the arrows, O king, shot by thousands by them, did no longer illuminate the ten points as before.

verses.sanskrit: तथा प्रयुध्यमानेषु पाण्डवेयेषु भारत।  दुर्योधनो महाराज व्यवागाहत तद्बलम्॥११॥
verses.english: The Pandava army, 0 Bharata being thus engaged in battle Duryodhana penetrated into them, Oking.

verses.sanskrit: सैन्धवस्य वधेनैव भृशं दुःखसमन्वितः।  मर्तव्यमिति सञ्चिन्त्य प्राविशच्च द्विषद्बलम्॥१२॥
नादयन् रथघोषेण कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्।  अभ्यवर्तत पुत्रस्ते पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥१३॥
verses.english: Causing the earth to tremble and resound with the rattle of his car, your son rushed against the Pandava army.

verses.sanskrit: स सन्निपातस्तुमुलस्तस्य तेषां च भारत।  अभवत्सर्वसैन्यानामभावकरणो महान्॥१४॥
verses.english: O Bharata, that dreadful clash between him and them caused a terrible slaughter of all the troops.

verses.sanskrit: यथा मध्यन्दिने सूर्यं प्रतपन्तं गभस्तिभिः।  तथा तव सुतं मध्ये प्रतपन्तं शरार्चिभिः॥१५॥
न शेकुर्भ्रातरं युद्धे पाण्डवाः समुदीक्षितुम्। पलायनकृतोत्साहा निरुत्साहा द्विषज्जये॥१६॥
verses.english: In that battle the Pandavas could not even look at their brother (i.e., Duryodhana) and despairing of conquering their enemy, they tried to flee (from the field).

verses.sanskrit: पर्यधावन्त पञ्चाला वध्यमाना महात्मना।  रुक्मपुङ्खैः प्रसन्नाग्रैस्तव पुत्रेण धन्विना॥१७॥
verses.english: The Panchalas, struck with gold-winged darts of blazing points, shot by your highsouled son armed with a bow, fled away.

verses.sanskrit: अद्यमानाः शरैस्तूर्णं न्यपतन्पाण्डुसैनिकाः।  न तादृशं रणे कर्म कृतवन्तस्तु तावकाः॥१८॥
verses.english: The Pandava soldiers smitten with sharpened darts fell (dead). Indeed the sons of Pandu could never perform such exploits in battle.

verses.sanskrit: यादृशं कृतवान् राजा पुत्रस्तव विशांपते।  पुत्रेण तव सा सेना पाण्डवी मथिता रणे॥१९॥
verses.english: As were achieved by your royal son, O lord of earth. In that encountei the Pandava army was crushed by your son.

verses.sanskrit: नलिनी द्विरदेनेव समन्तात्फुल्लपङ्कजा।  श्रीणतोयानिलार्काभ्यां हतत्विडिव पद्मिनी॥२०॥
verses.english: As lotuses are torn and crushed by a tusker. As lotuses are shorn of their beauty in consequence of the water (over which they grow) being dried up by the sun and the wind.

verses.sanskrit: बभूव पाण्डवी सेना तव पुत्रस्य तेजसा।  पाण्डुसेनां हतां दृष्ट्वा तव पुत्रेण भारत॥२१॥
verses.english: The Pandava army became so by virtue of the prowess of your son. Seeing, O Bharata, that the Pandava army was being destroyed by your son.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनपुरोगास्तु पञ्चालाः समुपाद्रवन्।  स भीमसेनं दशभिर्माद्रीपुत्रौ त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः॥२२॥
verses.english: The Panchalas led by Bhimasena advanced (against him). He then (pierced) Bhimasena with ten, each of the two sons of Madri with three.

verses.sanskrit: विराटद्रुपदौ षड्भिः शतेन च शिखण्डिनम्।  धृष्टद्युम्नं च सप्तत्या धर्मपुत्रं च सप्तभिः॥२३॥
verses.english: Virata and Drupada each with six, Shikandi with hundred, Dhrishtadyumna with hundred, the son of Dharma with seven.

verses.sanskrit: केकयांश्चैव चेदींश्च बहुभिर्निशितैः शरैः।  सात्वतं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा द्रौपदेयांस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः॥२४॥
verses.english: And the Kalkeyas and the Chedies with numerous keen darts. piercing Satvatta with five (arrows), each of the son of Draupadi with three.

verses.sanskrit: घटोत्कचं च समरे विद्ध्वा सिंह इवानदत्।  शतशश्चापरान्योधान्सद्विपांश्च महारणे॥२५॥
verses.english: And piercing Ghatotkacha too in battle he roared like a lion. Like the wrathful destroyer slaying the created beings, he cut down hundreds of other warriors and the bodies of horses and elephants in that terrific encounter. When he was thus destroying his enemies, his great bow, plaited at the back with gold.

verses.sanskrit: शरैरवचकर्तोग्रैः क्रुद्धोऽन्तक इव प्रजाः।  सा तेन पाण्डवी सेना वध्यमाना शिलीमुखैः॥२६॥
तव पुत्रेण संग्रामे विदुद्राव नराधिप।  तं तपन्तमिवादित्यं कुरुराजं महाहवे॥२७॥
verses.english: o king! The soldiers in the army of Pandavas could not even put an eye on Duryodhana, the Kuru king who was glowing like a son in that great battle. O great king! King Yudhishthira then rushed fast with an intention to kill your son, the king of Kuru, Duryodhana in furious mood.

verses.sanskrit: नाशकन्वीक्षितुं राजन्पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सैनिकाः।  ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा कुपितो राजसत्तम॥२८॥
अभ्यधावत्कुरुपात तव पुत्रं जिघांसया।  तावुभौ युधि कौरव्यौ समीयतुररिन्दमा॥२९॥
verses.english: Duryodhana, the warrior of Kuru clan and Yudhishthira both suppressor to enemy attacked furiously on each other with fantastic exhibition of valour for their respective interests.

verses.sanskrit: स्वार्थहेतोः पराक्रान्तौ दुर्योधनयुधिष्ठिरौ।  ततो दुर्योधनः क्रुद्धः शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः॥३०॥
विव्याध दशभिस्तूर्णं ध्वजं चिच्छेद चेषुणा।  इन्द्रसेनं त्रिभिश्चैव ललाटे जघ्निवान्नृप॥३१॥
verses.english: Duryodhana furiated enough, put ten arrows having bent knot on bow and shot at Yudhishthira. He was badly injured. He then shot an arrow again and cut-off the flag fixed on Yudhishthira chariot.

verses.sanskrit: सारथिं दयितं राज्ञः पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः।  धनुश्च पुनरन्येन चकर्तास्य महारथः॥३२॥
verses.english: O king! He shot again three arrows at Indrasena, the loyal charioteer of Yudhishthira and injured his forehead.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भिश्चतुरश्चैव बाणैर्विव्याध वाजिनः।  ततो युधिष्ठिरः क्रुद्धो निमेषादिव कार्मुकम्॥३३॥
verses.english: Duryodhana again shot an arrow which had cut-off the bow with Yudhishthira and penetrated his four horses by another four arrows he shot at them.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यदादाय वेगेन कौरवं प्रत्यवारयत्।  तस्य तान्निघ्नतः शत्रून् रुक्मपृष्ठं महद्धनुः॥३४॥
verses.english: King Yudhishthira furiated enormous, picked up immediately at an wink, another bow and prevented Duryodhana with a sharp blow.

verses.sanskrit: भल्लाभ्यां पाण्डवो ज्येष्ठस्त्रिधा चिच्छेद मारिष।  विव्याध चैनं दशभिः सम्यगस्तैः शितैः शरैः॥३५॥
verses.english: Revered king! Yudhishthira, the eldest Pandava splitted the huge bow, gold studded with Duryodhana up into three pieces by giving acute blows twice with Bhalla.

verses.sanskrit: मर्म भित्त्वा तु ते सर्वे संलग्नाः क्षितिमाविशन्।  ततः परिवृता योधाः परिवव्रुर्युधिष्ठिरम्॥३६॥
verses.english: He concomitantly injured Duryodhana too with a shot of ten sharp arrows. These arrows penetrated the sensitive parts in Duryodhana's body, made their way from them and sank deep in the earth.

verses.sanskrit: वृत्रहत्यै यथा देवाः परिवव्रुः पुरन्दरम्।  ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा तव पुत्रस्य मारिष।  शरं च सूर्यरश्म्याभमत्युग्रमनिवारणम्॥३७॥
हा हतोऽसीति राजानमुक्त्वाऽमुञ्चद्युधिष्ठिरः।  स तेनाकर्णमुक्तेन विद्धो बाणेन कौरवः॥३८॥
verses.english: Omajesty! Yudhishthira, then shot a dreadful and target hitting arrow glowing like sun beams at your son, king Duryodhana with a declaration-"Oh! You are killed."

verses.sanskrit: निषसाद रथोपस्थे भृशं संमूढचेतनः।  ततः पाञ्चाल्यसेनानां भृशमासीद्रवो महान्॥३९॥
verses.english: Duryodhana, the king of Kuru clan immediately lost conscious and seated with a thud at the rear part of his chariot when that arrow injured him.

verses.sanskrit: हतो राजेति राजेन्द्र मुदितानां समन्ततः।  बाणशब्दरवश्चोग्रः शुश्रुवे तत्र मारिष॥४०॥
verses.english: Then a great and tumultuous uproar arose from among the Panchala soldiers. O king of kings, that great noise was this “the king is slain.”

verses.sanskrit: अथ द्रोणो द्रुतं तत्र प्रत्यदृश्यत संयुगे।  हृष्टो दुर्योधनश्चापि दृढमादाय कार्मुकम्॥४१॥
verses.english: And, O Bharata, sharp whiz's of arrows were also heard there. Then Drona speedily appeared there in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति राजानं ब्रुवन्पाण्डवमभ्ययात्।  प्रत्युद्ययुस्तं त्वरिताः पञ्चाला जयगृद्धिनः॥४२॥
verses.english: Thereafter your highly puissant Duryodhana taking up another bow and addressing king Yudhishthira saying "wait wait" rushed against that son of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit: तान्द्रोणः प्रतिजग्राह परीप्सन्कुरुसत्तमम्।  चण्डवातोद्धुतान्मेघान्निघ्नन् रश्मिमुचो यथा॥४३॥
verses.english: The Panchalas too desirous of victory speedily followed the king. In order to save the foremost of the Kurus, Drona received them (i.e., their charge).

verses.sanskrit: ततो राजन्महानासीत्संग्रामो भूरिवर्धनः।  तावकानां परेषां च समेतानां युयुत्सया॥४४॥
verses.english: And then destroyed them all like the possessor of rays destroying the clouds driven to and fro by a terrific hurricane. Then there took place, O king, a terrific battle causing great havoc between you and your enemy's assembled troops eager for fight.
verses.bhavadeepa: रश्मिमुचः सूर्यः इगुपधलक्षणकप्रत्ययान्तः शब्दः बहुवचनमेवैतत्प्रलयसूचकमिति वा ॥४३॥
